Use `selenium-pw-migrator --mode <mode> --help` for command-specific help.

Modes:
  Stable public commands:
    init               Create a safe starter migration workspace with the onboarding wizard.
    start              Run the product-repo onboarding wizard and print the next safe command.
    pilot              Select a representative bounded migration slice before the first real batch.
    runbook            Generate a practical migration plan for a project before the first run.
    framework-matrix   Write explicit source and target test-framework support, detection, and readiness reports.
    playground         Create a five-minute public demo workspace with ready commands and expected outputs.
    playground-verify  Verify that a generated playground still has the complete public-demo contract.
    memory             Manage project-scoped migration memory for supervised runs.
    migration          Plan divide-and-conquer migration waves with project-scoped memory guidance.
    config-merge       Merge project-local wave config deltas into a reviewable adapter-config candidate.
    install-doctor     Explain the active install channel, resolved executable, version, and update command.
    release-doctor     Check NuGet/npm/standalone preview readiness before publishing the public tool.
    analyze            Parse and analyze Selenium tests without generating target files.
    migrate            Parse, adapt, and generate Playwright target files.
